_readme: Picture sources for the arena-images skill (.claude/skills/arena-images). Per category: kind = photo | logo | product; query = photo-search text ({item} = the item); prompt = AI description when nothing is found; hideName = the picture must not show the item's name (AI removal, else blur with --boxes; originals kept in archive/reveal/); prefer = file-name words (e.g. ["icon", "logo"]): use the article's first file with that word before its lead image; wikipedia = false skips the Wikipedia lead image. items: entry n = item <category>-<n>, in the order of src/content/categories.ts. An item is an English Wikipedia title (its lead image is tried first), 'File:<name>' to pin a Commons/Wikipedia file, and may end with '::<AI description>' for that item only. Categories missing here fall back to wiki-sources.json as kind photo.
